claim_text: Psyllium can affect absorption of some oral medicines; timing and spacing instructions should follow the exact product label and pharmacist guidance rather than a generic schedule.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People taking regular oral medicines and considering psyllium.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: Official product labeling provides medicine administration precautions; verify exact label.
limitations: Specific spacing varies by medicine and product; do not invent a universal interval.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
